title: SCRUM-85: PwD - Accessibility for Purchase Links - Accessibility Test Plan
overview: Accessibility test plan for purchase link accessibility: Buy Online heading semantic, each link has aria-label with action+destination+'opens in new tab', external link icons have hidden text, keyboard operable (Tab/Enter/Space), logical focus order, focus indicators ≥3:1, contrast ≥4.5:1, link states visually distinct, disabled links programmatically hidden, screen reader announces purpose, touch targets ≥44px, no focus loss.

testCases.title: Buy Online heading is semantic subheading navigable by screen readers
steps: Verify Buy Online heading is h2 or h3
Verify screen reader can navigate to it via heading shortcut

testCases.title: Each purchase link has aria-label with action, destination, and new tab
steps: Verify aria-label like 'Buy ProductName on Amazon – opens in new tab'

testCases.title: External link icons include hidden text for 'opens in new tab'
steps: Verify visually hidden text or aria-label includes 'opens in new tab'

testCases.title: Purchase links keyboard operable with Tab, Enter, Space
Focus order logical (after price → before reviews)
steps: Verify purchase links appear in logical order within popup

testCases.title: Link states (default, hover, focus, visited) visually distinct
Disabled/removed links programmatically hidden
steps: Verify not in DOM or display:none

testCases.title: Screen reader announces link purpose and context
steps: Navigate to link with screen reader
Verify announcement: 'Buy on Amazon, link, opens in new tab'

testCases.title: No unexpected navigation or focus loss after clicking link
steps: Verify no focus loss on original page

testCases.title: No keyboard traps in purchase links section
Complete purchase link workflow keyboard only
steps: Press Enter to open in new tab
